identifiability_verdict: STRUCTURAL DISCOVERY & IDENTIFIABILITY LIMITATION: In UCIP-20 BIND corpus, the mapping between entities and relations is a STRICT BIJECTION. Every entity appears in exactly ONE relation, and possesses exactly ONE ground-truth value. There are ZERO multi-relation entities and ZERO cross-entity shared values. Consequently, true compositional binding (e.g. testing whether entity X bound to relation R1 produces V1 while X bound to R2 produces V2) is STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE to test on this dataset, because no entity is ever queried on more than one relation. The task is strictly entity-indexed fact retrieval, not compositional binding.
